name: norm
description: Build and migrate Bland v2 agents: /norm:build creates new v2 agents (asking v1-or-v2 first), /norm:migrate converts v1 pathways/personas with the full hand-migration doctrine, plus snapshot audit and simulation verification. v2-only — v1 requests belong to the bland plugin.

BLAND_API_KEY.title: Bland API key
BLAND_API_KEY.description: From app.bland.ai/settings/api-keys. Must belong to the org that owns the agents.

BLAND_API_URL.title: Bland API URL (optional)
BLAND_API_URL.description: Defaults to production (https://api.bland.ai). Only override for dev/staging.
